steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Doctor, I took a quick stroll around. Didn't seem like there were any others.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Looks like we're gonna have to head back into the rainforest to look for her bunch after this.

steps.name: Peta
steps.text: ——! (Cry of victory)

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: Oh, Peta won.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: This Peta's pretty good. Makes me wanna rumble with him, actually.

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: Mm-hm! He's one of my tribe's warriors.

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: But he's definitely not as good as you, Gavial.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Haha, easy enough to say.

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: Come on, Gavial! You already came so close to becoming Great Chief over when we were little! Like you could lose to Peta!

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Hmm? Oh, yeah, that one time.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: I was super young. Thought the idea was so cool, I actually went in for the ceremony once.

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: Yeah, and you were already so super strong by then!

steps.name: Archosauria Warrior
steps.text: Gah...

steps.name: Archosauria Champion
steps.text: So that's all you Wilderness's Wills amount to!

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: S-Strong...

steps.name: Archosauria A
steps.text: Pfeh. All our warriors taken down like nothing.

steps.name: Archosauria B
steps.text: Let's go in together!

steps.name: Archosauria A
steps.text: We can't. No number at once will be enough... Can we only give up...?

steps.name: Archosauria Champion
steps.text: Who else wants to challenge me?! If you're all done, then it's just me versus the Great Chief!

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: I do!

steps.name: Archosauria Champion
steps.text: And you're... Wilderness's Will's orphan, Gavial?

steps.name: Archosauria Champion
steps.text: I hear you're a terror among the kids, but kids don't join the ceremony. Run back home and drink your milk. You've got a few more years.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Hmph! Let's see who wins first!

steps.name: Archosauria Champion
steps.text: Hah! You really are an orphan. You don't fear death?!

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: My tribespeople are my family! Cut the crap! Do you wanna go or not?!

steps.name: Archosauria Champion
steps.text: Heh! It's your funeral, brat!

steps.name: Archosauria Champion
steps.text: Im... Impossible... Just two punches...

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: Gavial's... so strong...

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Hmph! I guess that's all, then!

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Who else wants some?

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: Didn't she ever tell you?

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Didn't I?

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Eh. I guess I didn't, but it's not like it was important enough to come up.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Dunno who my parents were, but that's not all that rare in these parts.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Doctor, it may not make sense to you, but death is pretty common out here.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: It doesn't even take a Catastrophe—honestly, nobody here knows what Catastrophes are—a single cold or a bout of bad weather can kill off folks who would've lived otherwise.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: I'd guess my parents just went like that.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Eugh. Let's quit this talk. All you need to know is the tribe raised me.

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: Gavial...

options: Well, at least you're healthier than anyone now.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: You can quit it, Doctor. I don't really need the pity treatment.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: I'm not the only orphan ever. Plenty of families around here that link up and raise a bunch of 'em together. It happens all the time.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Doctor, don't overthink it.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: I didn't even know it was unusual until I left.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Actually, I guess you could say it's what made me decide to do medicine.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Haha. Yeah.

options: So how'd that ceremony back then turn out?

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: That one, uh...
Found you, you goshdarned bounty hunter!

steps.name: Peta
steps.text: Who's that?!

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Huh? I know that voice...

steps.name: Ceobe
steps.text: Give the Doctor back!

steps.name: Peta
steps.text: What the hell are you talking about?

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Kay?!

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Tomimi, didn't we tell your people to tie her up and take her back to the tribe?

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: Um, I thought we did?

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: She's real strong. Kid must've just plowed past everyone...

steps.name: Ceobe
steps.text: Bounty hunter! Hand the Doctor over!

steps.name: Ceobe
steps.text: Or else I'm gonna chase you to the end of the world, if I hafta!

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Tch. Smartest girl ever. Looks like she still hasn't even sobered up.

steps.name: Peta
steps.text: Gahhh!

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: She sent Peta flying!

steps.name: Archosauria A
steps.text: She finished Peta off!

steps.name: Archosauria B
steps.text: She's insanely strong...

steps.name: Archosauria C
steps.text: Where'd that weirdo come from?! Which tribe is she?!

steps.name: Archosauria A
steps.text: No idea! I don't even understand what she's saying!

steps.name: Archosauria B
steps.text: Forget it! All we gotta do is beat her, right?

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Oh, damn it. Now they think Kay's the new challenger, don't they?

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: Gavial, should we go in and help?

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: No, wait. The dumb little kid is way tougher than you'd think. She can handle this. If we go in, we're just gonna add to the body count.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: But something tells me this might get messy. Doctor, see if you can help Tomimi's lackeys get this under control.
